## Assessment (data verification verdict)

- VERDICT: USA30 tape ACCEPTED FOR THE RESTRICTED BINDING WINDOW 2025-07-01
  -> 2026-08-31 (user-confirmed 2026-09-05), with per-month coverage declared
  below. The 2020-01 -> 2025-06 portion is declared INADEQUATE for
  bar-machine studies and EXCLUDED from the MOKAMEL_FLIP USA30 native
  re-test on coverage grounds alone (no strategy number was computed for
  any window before this exclusion was fixed).
- Stitch quality: 0 monotonic violations, 0 duplicate timestamps, 0 spread
  inversions, 0 non-positive quotes across 143,822,709 ticks. The
  2024-12-31 vendor hole (dukascopy-node exclusive 'to' date) was patched
  with a same-source fetch (usa30idxusd-tick-2024-12-31-2025-01-01.csv,
  59,172 ticks, 2024-12-31 03:00 UTC -> 2025-01-01 02:33 UTC), bridging
  file2's last tick (2024-12-30 23:59:57) and file3's first tick
  (2025-01-01 23:00) across the New Year closure with no overlap.
- CRITICAL LIMITATION (instrument-specific, verified): the Dukascopy
  USA30.IDX archive contains scattered EMPTY HOURS inside the US cash
  session. In the MOKAMEL machine window [09:30,14:30) NY, mean M5 bars
  per cash day = 26 (2020) / 23 (2021) / 24 (2022) / 28 (2023) / 34
  (2024) / 43-53 (2025H2) / 59-60 (2026), vs 60 expected. Only 287 of
  1,575 days 2020-2026 are 100 percent complete; 899 days have the
  wall-570 bar at all. All such gaps start exactly at :59:59 hour
  boundaries with whole-hour durations. Verified NOT a download artifact:
  a fresh no-cache refetch of 2024-10-09 (probe kept in
  C:\Users\Milad\download\probe) returns the same missing NY hours
  09-10 and 13-15 that the tape has. The USA500 and XAUUSD archives from
  the identical pipeline are complete, so this is specific to the
  vendor's USA30 index history, improving to essentially complete in
  2026.
- Session structure: daily tape typically 20:00 -> 16:14 NY next day
  (overnight futures hours + cash session), nightly halt ~16:15-20:00 NY
  (~5h, the dominant >= 3h gap class), plus weekends and holidays; all
  412 gaps > 14h are weekends/holiday weekends (max 85h).
- Point convention (Q2): quotes carry 2 decimals in 2020-2022 and 3
  decimals from 2023 onward (sub-point granularity only). One USA30
  index point = 1.0 price units; MOKAMEL 40/80 = 40/80 index points.
- Cost floor (Q4): cash [09:30,16:00) NY median spread 2.282 index
  points (mean 2.274, p90 2.558, p99 5.67); full-tape median 2.498
  (overnight 3.99). The US500 0.51 pt floor is NOT reused.
- Largest consecutive-tick mid changes are the real historic Dow moves
  (2025-04-09 tariff-pause +2,505 pts intraday sequence; 2025-04-07
  -1,977; COVID 2020-03); no bad prints found.
- Bar exports verified: M1 1,167,943 bars; M5 233,857 bars; M1->M5
  agreement IDENTICAL. Day universe usa30_days.csv: 2,052 rows.
- Known edge truncations (declared): tape starts 2020-01-01 23:00 UTC;
  ends 2026-09-01 23:59:50 UTC (vendor 'to' boundary excludes 2026-09-02).
